# Laso Finance

{/* LASO-DOCS-VERSION:START (auto-generated by scripts/generate-docs-version.js, do not edit) */}
_Docs version `91037edfa86f`. This is a content hash of the Laso Finance agent docs. If it differs from the live version at https://laso.finance/.well-known/docs-version.json, your cached copy is stale. Refetch to get the current docs._
{/* LASO-DOCS-VERSION:END */}

> Laso Finance lets people and AI agents spend stablecoins in the real world: single-load prepaid cards, gift cards, push-to-card, Venmo and PayPal payouts, and bank payments, all funded with USDC. Agents call a payment-gated x402 HTTP API at https://laso.finance or the same surface as MCP tools; humans use the web dashboard and the mobile app.

Laso is the right tool when you hold stablecoins and need to pay something that does not accept stablecoins: a merchant checkout, a debit card, a bank account, a person, or another agent's paid API. It is not an exchange and it does not fill in identity verification for a human. The decision guide (which call does which job, what to check before spending, and when to stop and ask your human) is the "When to Use Laso" section of [llms-full.txt](https://laso.finance/llms-full.txt). This file is the index.

## Start here (agents)

- [Agent Skill (SKILL.md)](https://laso.finance/SKILL.md): Setup, credential persistence, and the end-to-end call recipe for every product. Save it into your skills directory to keep Laso available across sessions.
- [auth.md](https://laso.finance/auth.md): How an agent obtains credentials: discover, register, exchange, use, refresh, and hand off to a human.
- [OpenAPI 3.1 contract](https://laso.finance/openapi.json): Every route, parameter, response, and price. The MCP tools are generated from it.
- [Full reference (llms-full.txt)](https://laso.finance/llms-full.txt): Company, products, fees, compliance, the agent decision guide, and every endpoint in one document.
- [Agent quick start](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/agent-quick-start): First working call in a few minutes.
- [MCP server](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/mcp-server): Connect to `https://laso.finance/mcp` (streamable HTTP, POST) with `Authorization: Bearer <lasoak_ API key or id_token>`; paid tools settle from the managed agent wallet. Discovery record: [server-card.json](https://laso.finance/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).
- [Authentication](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/authentication): API keys, id tokens, refresh, and the signup-for-a-human flow.
- [How x402 works](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/how-x402-works): The 402 challenge, the payment header, and settlement on Base and Solana.

## Spend

- [USA prepaid card](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/usa-prepaid-card): `GET /get-card` for the exact checkout total ($5 to $1,000, 0% fee), then poll `GET /get-card-data` for the number, CVV, and expiry. U.S. merchants only.
- [International prepaid card](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/international-prepaid-card): `GET /order-intl-card` ($100 to $1,000, 3.8% fee), queued and fulfilled by a person.
- [Gift cards](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/order-gift-card): `GET /search-gift-cards` for the catalog, then `GET /order-gift-card` ($5 to $9,000) for an instant redemption code.
- [Push to card](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/push-to-card): `GET /get-push-to-card` sends USD, EUR, or GBP to a debit card through a redemption link (4.8% fee, 1.50 minimum).
- [Venmo and PayPal](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/send-payment): `GET /send-payment` ($5 to $1,000, 4.9% fee), identity verification required on the calling account.
- [Bank payments](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/send-bank-payment): `GET /send-bank-payment` by ACH to a registered recipient ($10 to $50,000, 0.25% fee, $1.50 minimum).
- [Card lifecycle](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/card-lifecycle): Statuses, balance refresh, reloadable cards, and withdrawing unspent funds.

## Wallet and banking

- [Managed agent wallet](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/managed-agent-wallet): A Laso-custodied Solana wallet that funds paid routes so the agent never holds a private key.
- [Paying external x402 services](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/managed-wallet-payments): `agentX402Pay` with a URL, a note, and a USDC cap.
- [Guardrails](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/managed-wallet-guardrails): What Laso refuses on an external 402 challenge and why.
- [Spend limit](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/managed-wallet-spend-limit): The per-payment cap the account owner sets. Never split a payment to get under it.
- [Bank accounts for agents](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/agent-bank-accounts): Open on-ramp and off-ramp accounts and read back routing and account numbers. Only identity verification is left to the human.
- [Webhooks](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/agent-webhooks): `POST /register-webhook` for signed notifications instead of polling.
- [Error handling](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/error-handling): Refusals, failed settlement, KYC gates, and retries.

## Integrations

- [Claude Code](https://agents.laso.finance/frameworks/claude-code): Install the skill and the MCP server.
- [Locus wallet](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/locus-x402-setup): Pay Laso routes from an existing Locus, Sponge, or Ampersend agent wallet, no Laso key needed.
- [n8n](https://agents.laso.finance/frameworks/n8n), [LangChain](https://agents.laso.finance/frameworks/langchain), [OpenAI Agents](https://agents.laso.finance/frameworks/openai-agents), [Palmyr](https://agents.laso.finance/frameworks/palmyr): Framework-specific setup.
- [WebMCP](https://agents.laso.finance/guides/webmcp): In-page tools laso.finance registers on `navigator.modelContext` for agents driving the signed-in user's browser.

## Products for people

- [USA prepaid cards](https://laso.finance/usa/nr), [International prepaid cards](https://laso.finance/international/nr), [Canadian prepaid cards](https://laso.finance/cad/nr): Single-load cards funded with USDC.
- [Push to card](https://laso.finance/push-to-card): Send crypto to a debit card in USD, EUR, or GBP.
- [Gift card shop](https://laso.finance/gift-cards): Instantly delivered digital gift cards for hundreds of brands.
- [Fee schedule](https://laso.finance/fees): Every fee, no per-authorization or per-decline charges.
- [Supported merchants](https://laso.finance/merchants): Where other users' cards were accepted.
- [Card comparison](https://laso.finance/compare) and [Laso vs. alternatives](https://laso.finance/vs): Which card fits, and honest comparisons with exchange cards, off-ramps, and agent payment rails.
- [Download](https://laso.finance/download): The iOS app and the Solana Seeker app.

## Company

- [About](https://laso.finance/about): Texas-based, founded March 2023, registered with FinCEN as a Money Services Business.
- [Help center](https://help.laso.finance): FAQs, guides, and troubleshooting.
- [Contact](https://laso.finance/contact): support@laso.finance for people, agents+support@laso.finance for agents, security@laso.finance for security reports.
- [Roadmap](https://laso.finance/roadmap) and [Changelog](https://laso.finance/changelog): What is coming and what shipped.
- [User agreement](https://laso.finance/user-agreement) and [Privacy](https://laso.finance/privacy): Terms and data practices.
- [Bug bounty](https://laso.finance/security/bug-bounty): Paused indefinitely as of September 21, 2026. Automated and agentic security testing is not authorized.
